module fsm_heldout_08 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [1:0] coin,
  output dispense
);

  typedef enum reg [1:0] {
    STATE_IDLE     = 2'd0,
    STATE_NICKEL   = 2'd1,
    STATE_DIME     = 2'd2,
    STATE_QUARTER  = 2'd3
  } state_t;

  state_t current_state, next_state;
  reg dispense_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
      dispense_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      current_state <= next_state;
      dispense_reg <= 1'b0;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    next_state = current_state;
    case (current_state)
      STATE_IDLE: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_NICKEL;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_NICKEL: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_DIME: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_QUARTER: begin
        if (coin == 2'd0) begin // no coin
          next_state = STATE_IDLE;
        end else if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_NICKEL;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      default: next_state = STATE_IDLE;
    endcase
  end

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      dispense <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case (current_state)
        STATE_QUARTER: begin
          if (coin == 2'd0) begin // no coin
            dispense <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            dispense <= 1'b0;
          end
        end
        default: dispense <= 1'b0;
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module fsm_heldout_08 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [1:0] coin,
  output dispense
);

  typedef enum reg [1:0] {
    STATE_IDLE     = 2'd0,
    STATE_NICKEL   = 2'd1,
    STATE_DIME     = 2'd2,
    STATE_QUARTER  = 2'd3
  } state_t;

  state_t current_state, next_state;
  reg dispense_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      current_state <= STATE_IDLE;
      dispense_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      current_state <= next_state;
      dispense_reg <= 1'b0;
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    next_state = current_state;
    case (current_state)
      STATE_IDLE: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_NICKEL;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_NICKEL: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_DIME: begin
        if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      STATE_QUARTER: begin
        if (coin == 2'd0) begin // no coin
          next_state = STATE_IDLE;
        end else if (coin == 2'd1) begin // nickel
          next_state = STATE_NICKEL;
        end else if (coin == 2'd2) begin // dime
          next_state = STATE_DIME;
        end else if (coin == 2'd3) begin // quarter
          next_state = STATE_QUARTER;
        end
      end

      default: next_state = STATE_IDLE;
    endcase
  end

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      dispense <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case (current_state)
        STATE_QUARTER: begin
          if (coin == 2'd0) begin // no coin
            dispense <= 1'b1;
          end else begin
            dispense <= 1'b0;
          end
        end
        default: dispense <= 1'b0;
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule
